lines.text: During King Herod's time, Magi from the east arrived in Jerusalem asking where the King of the Jews was.
Disturbed Herod asked the chief priests and scribes where the Christ would be born, and they said Bethlehem in Egypt.
Herod secretly learned from the Magi when the star appeared and sent them to Bethlehem to search for the Child.
The star stood over where the Child was, and the Magi worshiped Him and gave Him gold, frankincense and myrrh.
Warned by an angel not to return to Herod, the Magi went home by another route.
